# E0500: repeated row element

A row names each effect once. Delete the repeated one.

- Rule: [`effects.repeated-elements`](../../reference/12-effects.md#effects.repeated-elements)
- Reported at: the repeated element.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0500:1
fn log(message: str) / {io, io} { print(message) }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn log(message: str) / io { print(message) }
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0500_repeated_row_element.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0500_repeated_row_element.lt):

```text
── REPEATED ROW ELEMENT ──────────── E0500_repeated_row_element.lt:1:29  [E0500]

`io` is already in this row:

  1 │ fn log(message: str) / {io, io} { print(message) }
    │                             ^^

A row names each effect once. Delete the repeated one.

To fix it, delete the repeated `io`:

  1 │ fn log(message: str) / {io, io} { print(message) }
    │                           ----
```
